jobs.input: one complete 104-row main composite run manifest
one complete 104-row resend composite run manifest

materialization: No scorer starts until both attempts are sealed, both complete 104-row prediction files exist, both run manifests verify, and both complete human-ledger cell files validate. The launcher writes the two exact manifest paths to score-jobs.jsonl and invokes the unchanged official finalizer once per manifest in one two-worker wave.
aggregation_rule: Never shard a dataset for scoring and never average shard-level metrics. Each worker invokes the unchanged official scorer on one complete 104-row composite.
timing_receipt: batch-summary.json records outer wall time, per-job time, effective speedup, scorer identity, and result hashes.
